subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: How should strict reasoning-tag sanitization handle an unclosed `<think>` when the original text also contains a `<final>` answer boundary?
rationale: The current fallback recovers otherwise-empty replies but can expose hidden reasoning after final markers are stripped; choosing the replacement semantics is a security boundary and product behavior decision rather than a purely mechanical WhatsApp fix.

options.title: Recover only the final answer
options.body: When an original `<final>` boundary is present, return only that final body and suppress the unclosed `<think>` region, then add shared and WhatsApp/Telegram coverage.

options.title: Fail closed on malformed reasoning
options.body: Suppress the entire malformed unclosed reasoning payload unless a structured final-answer block is already known, favoring secrecy over answer recovery.

options.title: Keep current fallback
options.body: Accept the risk that malformed tagged output can expose reasoning in exchange for preserving more malformed local-model replies.

recommendation.title: Recover only the final answer
recommendation.body: When an original `<final>` boundary is present, return only that final body and suppress the unclosed `<think>` region, then add shared and WhatsApp/Telegram coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved behavior is in the shared sanitizer fallback and final-tag parsing path where steipete has the clearest recent history.
